zh-CN.summary: 在 CPU 上运行本地模型，API 只能从集群内访问。

zh-TW.summary: 在 CPU 上執行本機模型，API 只能從叢集內連線。

metadata.name: Ollama
metadata.summary: Runs local models on the CPU; its API is reachable only inside the cluster.

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 1000 运行，没有额外的系统权限，镜像只读。API 没有登录验证，只有同一个命名空间里、带有指定标签的客户端连得到。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 1000 執行，沒有額外的系統權限，映像檔唯讀。API 沒有登入驗證，只有同一個命名空間裡、帶有指定標籤的用戶端連得到。

zh-CN.mitigation: 没有 Ingress 也没有 NodePort。只有这个命名空间里、带有标签 templates.zeabur.com/ollama-client=true 的可信 Pod 连得进来。不要给这个服务加公开路由，因为它没有登录验证。
zh-CN.risk: Ollama API 没有登录验证，连得到的人都能管理模型。

zh-TW.mitigation: 沒有 Ingress 也沒有 NodePort。只有這個命名空間裡、帶有標籤 templates.zeabur.com/ollama-client=true 的可信任 Pod 連得進來。不要幫這個服務加公開路由，因為它沒有登入驗證。
zh-TW.risk: Ollama API 沒有登入驗證，連得到的人都能管理模型。

risks.mitigation: There is no Ingress or NodePort. Only trusted pods in this namespace that carry the label templates.zeabur.com/ollama-client=true can connect. Do not attach a public route to this service, because it has no sign-in.
risks.risk: The Ollama API has no sign-in, and anyone who can reach it can manage models.

zh-CN.mitigation: 不会预先加载任何模型。请先看过每个模型的许可和大小，再到 Pod 里运行 `ollama pull MODEL`。Pod 一次只加载一个模型，一次只处理一个请求。内存上限是 8Gi，存储卷是 50Gi，所以多数大型模型放不下。
zh-CN.risk: 每个模型都有自己的许可，跟 Ollama 软件本身的 MIT 许可无关。模型文件也可能把内存和磁盘用光。

zh-TW.mitigation: 不會預先載入任何模型。請先看過每個模型的授權和大小，再到 Pod 裡執行 `ollama pull MODEL`。Pod 一次只載入一個模型，一次只處理一個請求。記憶體上限是 8Gi，儲存空間是 50Gi，所以多數大型模型放不下。
zh-TW.risk: 每個模型都有自己的授權，跟 Ollama 軟體本身的 MIT 授權無關。模型檔也可能把記憶體和磁碟吃光。

risks.mitigation: No model is preloaded. Read each model's license and check its size, then run `ollama pull MODEL` in the Pod. The Pod loads one model and serves one request at a time. It has an 8Gi memory limit and a 50Gi volume, so most large models do not fit.
risks.risk: Each model has its own license, separate from the MIT license of the Ollama software. Model files can also use up all your RAM and disk.

security.summary: The container runs as UID 1000 with no extra system privileges and a read-only image. The API has no sign-in. Only clients in the same namespace that carry a specific label can reach it.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ollama-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 50Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ollama
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  revisionHistoryLimit: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ollama
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: ollama
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ollama
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: ollama
        image: docker.io/ollama/ollama:0.40.14@sha256:ebaef4f4c5d93660e1f25f8ad085a112f51ccfb0e8458073e71793959dba91c9
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 11434
        env:
        - name: HOME
          value: /data
        - name: OLLAMA_MODELS
          value: /data/models
        - name: OLLAMA_HOST
          value: 0.0.0.0:11434
        - name: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
          value: '1'
        - name: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS
          value: '1'
        - name: OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD
          value: 'true'
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 2Gi
          limits:
            cpu: '4'
            memory: 8Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /data
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/tags
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 90
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/tags
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/tags
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ollama-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ollama
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ollama
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 11434
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: ollama-access
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: ollama
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ollama
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          templates.zeabur.com/template: ollama
          templates.zeabur.com/ollama-client: 'true'
    ports:
    - port: 11434
      protocol: TCP
